citations.cypher:
CALL {
  MATCH (e:Event) WHERE e.timestamp_utc >= '2025-12-08T00:00:00Z' AND e.timestamp_utc < '2025-12-09T00:00:00Z'
  WITH substring(e.timestamp_utc, 0, 13) + ':00:00Z' AS hour, count(*) AS n
  RETURN hour, n
  UNION ALL
  MATCH (ch:CrowdHour) WHERE ch.hour_utc >= '2025-12-08T00:00:00Z' AND ch.hour_utc < '2025-12-09T00:00:00Z'
  RETURN ch.hour_utc AS hour, ch.event_count AS n
}
WITH hour, sum(n) AS total_events
ORDER BY total_events DESC
LIMIT 5
WITH hour, total_events
CALL {
  MATCH (ch:CrowdHour) WHERE ch.hour_utc >= '2025-12-08T00:00:00Z' AND ch.hour_utc < '2025-12-09T00:00:00Z'
  RETURN ch.camera_location AS location, avg(ch.avg_hc) AS avg_head_count, max(ch.peak_hc) AS peak_head_count
}
RETURN hour, total_events, location, avg_head_count, peak_head_count
ORDER BY peak_head_count DESC
LIMIT 5
